provenance.evidence: ROM scene 5 record 48 at 0x067C4A publishes event 2. Although event-table row 2 at 0x0679C8 is 0x23, ROM 0x1FA78 intercepts scene 5/event 2, selects mode profile 0x1220A8, menu mode 7/result 1, and the Wire-Masters prompt at 0x110EAA. Default result calls 0x56AC0; signed alternate results play the package record and return without opening the service.
